name: mirror-selfie-sudden-flood
image_purpose: Reel keyframe and surreal visual concept

prompt.project_info: Create a photorealistic cinematic still from a handheld mirror-selfie flood concept, preserving the frozen calm subject and physically dynamic water environment.
prompt.main_subject: Approved adult woman with curly hair in a messy bun, wearing a black vest over a white shirt and ripped blue jeans, holding a phone toward a mirror with a faint calm smile. Keep her body, face, and pose still as a surreal contrast to the flooding room.
prompt.composition_elements: Handheld smartphone mirror perspective with subtle natural shake, bedroom mirror, bed, bookshelf, plants, and water rapidly rising from all directions to submerge the room. Show clear water ripples, bubbles, splashes, floating particles, refraction, and warped mirror reflections. Vertical 9:16 keyframe.
prompt.lighting_and_atmosphere: Dramatic realistic indoor lighting refracted through clear water, cinematic contrast, surreal calm-versus-chaos atmosphere, natural textures and no artificial gloss.
prompt.technical_specs: Photorealistic smartphone cinematic still, vertical 9:16, realistic water physics and refraction, handheld perspective, high detail without 3D-render appearance.
prompt.generated_prompt_string: Photorealistic vertical 9:16 cinematic still from a handheld smartphone mirror selfie: an approved adult woman with curly hair in a messy bun, wearing a black vest over a white shirt and ripped blue jeans, holds her phone toward the mirror with a faint calm smile and remains completely still. Realistic clear water rapidly floods the bedroom from all directions, submerging the bed, bookshelf, and plants; show fast ripples, bubbles, splashes, floating particles, water refraction, shimmering reflections, and slightly warped mirror visuals. Dramatic realistic lighting, surreal contrast between frozen subject and chaotic environment, cinematic realism.
prompt.negative_prompt: explicit, nsfw, overly revealing, sexualized pose, exposed intimate areas, minors, celebrity likeness, public figure likeness, graphic injury, drowning, blood, distorted anatomy, plastic skin, waxy, over-smooth, over-saturated, airbrushed, HDR look, cartoon, 3D render, watermark

assets.name: mirror-selfie-sudden-flood.jpg
assets.usage: Preserve the approved adult's face, hair, black vest, white shirt, jeans, phone, mirror, room, frozen pose, and water concept.

reference_elements.prompt_instructions: Attach the required reference image. Preserve adult identity, outfit, pose, room layout, mirror perspective, water behavior, and lighting. Clothing, furniture, and water elements may be replaced while retaining the same surreal flood composition. Do not invent typography or logos.
